SERVICE_NAME.description: Name of the service (used in init script header and Provides:)

SERVICE_DESCRIPTION.description: Short service description (used in DESC and log messages)

SERVICE_LONG_DESCRIPTION.description: Long service description (used in Description: header)

PROJECT_NAME.description: Project name, also used as system user/group

SERVICE_SUFFIX.description: Suffix for the service name, appended after PROJECT_NAME-

UWSGI_PORT.description: Port for uWSGI to bind to

UWSGI_INI_APP.description: Path to uWSGI application entry point
